derivation: For each selected stored row, require direction coefficients a_i*N_i with a_i>0, eta coefficient exactly1, and N the fixed206-row conserving star with205independent columns. Each column has exactly one+1 and one-1 at the shared pivot.
Define alpha_i=1/exact_binary64(a_i), S=sum(alpha_i), lambda_i=alpha_i/S. Then lambda>=0, sum(lambda)=1, and sum(lambda_i*a_i*N_i)=0 exactly.

For stored RHS b_i, every feasible full interior point satisfies eta<=B=sum(lambda_i*exact_binary64(b_i)). This is an exact-real dual bound for these stored rows, provided the input associations pass.
Use reciprocal actual stored coefficients, not the original rational interval widths: HN uses a rounded reciprocal while RHS is rounded independently.

This gives no full primal witness, no guarantee that B is the full optimum, and no finite encoding or physical admission. Numerical encoding of the dual must still pass all full-original sign, stationarity and absolute-gap gates.
